CHAPTER 1 · ITEM 07 / 10

Interaction, markets and government

Specialization & exchange專門化與交換

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain how specialization and voluntary trade can benefit participants.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

專門化讓人集中於機會成本較低的活動。適當交易條件下，雙方都可得到比自行生產更好的消費組合。

Specialization lets people concentrate on activities with lower relative opportunity cost. Voluntary exchange can then give both a more valuable consumption bundle. Gains depend on the trade terms and available alternatives.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A gives up 2 meals to make a shirt; B gives up 4. A sells a shirt for 3 meals: A gains 1 meal and B saves 1 meal. 一件衫換三餐令雙方獲益。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A's cost of a shirt is 2 meals; B's is 4. Which trade price benefits both strictly? 何種價格令雙方嚴格得益？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
